T0564.title: Commission Fraud
T0564.definition: Abuse of commission rules through fake traffic, self-dealing, hijacking, or manipulated conversions.
T0564.description: Commission fraud abuses channel-settlement rules through fake conversions, attribution theft, self-dealing, or manipulated orders. Detection requires analysis of click paths, account relationships, order authenticity, channel history, and commission concentration.
T0564.usageExample: Assess Commission Fraud related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
